The Grand Exchange Market Watch is a guide and information resource for you to track prices and other information for items traded on the Grand Exchange within Old School RuneScape. The information here is obtained from other traders and players who use the exchange, and you are encouraged to help participate in sharing this trading information.

The Grand Exchange Prices can be found on the official website here. The Old School Wiki's real-time price guide can be found here.

Market indices

[edit source]

The following are some "average prices" to try and get an idea of the general health of Old School RuneScape's economy. As of 13 June 2020, the index was started at a base value of 100, and the current value is a general reflection of how prices have gone up or down since then. Below are the guide prices for items on the Grand Exchange.

Skill Details
Construction Building and garden supplies
Construction flatpacks Construction flatpacks
Cooking Food and ingredients
Crafting Leather, jewellery, and crafting items
Farming Seeds, saplings, produce, and farming tools
Firemaking Light sources and logs
Fishing Fish, baits, fishing equipment and boosts
Fletching Logs, unstrung bows, ammunition and boosts
Herblore Herbs, potions and ingredients
Hunter Camouflage gear, supplies, drops, baits, and boosts
Magic Runes, wizard clothing and staves
Melee armour Melee armour and accessories
Melee weapons Melee weapons
Mining Pickaxes, ores, gems and essence
Prayer Bones, potions, prayer armour, prayer items
Ranged Ranged weapons, ammunitions, armour and cannon parts
Runecraft Runes, essence, talismans and tiaras
Sailing Sailing ressources and shipbuilding materials
Slayer Slayer equipment, drops, and boosts
Smithing Ores, bars, weapons, armour and fletching items
Woodcutting Logs, hatchets, jungle area necessities and boosts

Other items

[edit source]
Items Details
Treasure Trails Coveted items from Treasure Trails
God Wars Dungeon Items related to the God Wars Dungeon
Non-combat minigames Items related to various minigames, except combat minigames
Combat minigames Items related to combat minigames
Seasonal Items related to seasonal content: holiday events and leagues
Raids Items related to Raids
Most traded items Items which have been in the top 100 most traded list
Most expensive items Items which have been in the top 400 most expensive list
Most expensive F2P items Items which have been in the top 400 most expensive F2P list
Alchemy items Items which can be profitable with High Level Alchemy (and Low Level Alchemy)
General Store items Items which can be profitable by sale to a general store
Shops Items which can be profitable to buy in a shop and sell to the Grand Exchange
Non-combat clothing Non-combat clothing
Item Sets Packaged Item Sets
Potions Potions and their different dosage variants
Miscellaneous items Items not otherwise categorised
